# 删除指定脸库的所有成员
##### 简要描述

- ChannelID为通道号，IPC仅支持一个通道，所以填1

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| GroupID | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">脸库ID，从0自增</span> | 是 |
| IsAbsoluteDelete | boolean | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">是否完全删除脸库所有成员</span> | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroup/1/DeleteSpecificGroupIDItems HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 5a5fd0b2-fe56-4870-ba8d-6d1d266e175a
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 164

<?xml version = "1.0" encoding = "utf-8"?>
<DeleteSpecificGroupItems>
<GroupID>0</GroupID>
<IsAbsoluteDelete>true<IsAbsoluteDelete>
<DeleteSpecificGroupItems>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 205

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceGroup/1/DeleteSpecificGroupIDItems</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceGroup/ChannelID/DeleteSpecificGroupIDItems` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
{}

```
